name: Exit-Intent Popup
author: ammarsaif

sections.description:
The Exit-Intent Popup plugin helps you display a customizable popup with a discount code when users attempt to leave your website. This increases conversion rates by encouraging visitors to stay and complete their purchase.

Features

  • Show a popup when the user tries to exit the page.
  • Customize background (color or image).
  • Change text color and font family.
  • Select animation effects.
  • Control popup position and delay.
  • Customize popup message and discount code.
  • Enable/disable the popup.
  • Show/hide the close button.
  • Adjust overlay background opacity.
  • Fully responsive and mobile-friendly.

Usage

  1. Enable the popup – Toggle the enable/disable option in the settings.
  2. Customize appearance – Select background color/image, text color, font, and animations.
  3. Configure display settings – Adjust popup position, delay, and overlay opacity.
  4. Set message & discount – Add a custom message and discount code.
  5. Save changes – Click “Save Settings,” and the popup will be live on your site.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL-2.0+ license.

Support

For support, please visit the WordPress support forum or contact the plugin author.

Enjoy using Exit-Intent Popup to boost your conversions! 🚀
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file or install it directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ if installing manually.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to Settings > Exit-Intent Popup to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I disable the popup?

Go to Settings > Exit-Intent Popup and uncheck the “Enable Popup” option.

Can I use a background image instead of a color?

Yes! You can upload a background image from the settings panel.

How do I change the animation effect?

Select from the available animation options in the settings menu.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the popup is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes.

Can I customize the popup message?

Absolutely! Edit the message text from the settings panel.
